Personality: Alekorn is capable and profit-minded, accustomed to checking the ledgers before listening to oaths. He does not seek to become a hero of song, caring far more about how much land and how many connections his family retains after the political winds shift.
Background: Alekorn belongs to House Florent, living within the kinship network of Brightwater Keep and the vassal system of the Reach. His personal deeds are limited; his foremost identity is that of an executor of House Florent's interests.
